metadata.title: 100 Shared Goals for Human Flourishing
metadata.handling: Do not overwrite or migrate HFL vote state; import into separate collection under human review.

categories: Economic security and freedom from desperation

goals.title: Easy Access to Public Help
goals.sharedGoal: People can discover and receive assistance they qualify for without unnecessary paperwork or stigma.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer automated eligibility checks and opt-in enrollment for existing benefits, with secure records and clear appeals.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Prevent incorrect enrollment, intrusive data sharing, and mistaken eligibility decisions.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: A Good Start for Every Child
goals.sharedGoal: Every child has a realistic opportunity to grow up safe, nourished, housed, and supported.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Create a refundable monthly child tax credit that reaches families with the lowest incomes.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Assess fiscal cost, benefit phase-outs, and interactions with other assistance.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Work That Improves People's Lives
goals.sharedGoal: People who work can build financial stability without being trapped by confusing benefit rules.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand earned-income tax credits, including support for workers without dependent children.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Design smooth phase-outs and guard against filing complexity and fraud.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Simple and Understandable Taxes
goals.sharedGoal: People can understand their obligations and comply without avoidable expense or effort.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Provide free prefilled tax returns when government information is sufficient, with correction and opt-out routes.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect sensitive data and preserve choice of tax preparer.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Security When Life Goes Wrong
goals.sharedGoal: Households have practical tools to recover from financial emergencies.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Match qualified savings for lower-income households up to a modest emergency reserve.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Ensure withdrawals remain accessible and program administration is affordable.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Fair and Transparent Borrowing
goals.sharedGoal: People can borrow without predatory terms or hidden costs.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Limit exploitative financing charges, disclose total costs clearly, and expand affordable lending options.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Monitor credit availability so restrictions do not push borrowers into worse alternatives.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Fairness in Fines and Penalties
goals.sharedGoal: Punishments are proportionate, understandable, and open to appeal.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Introduce means-sensitive civil fines for suitable offenses and fair ability-to-pay hearings.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect equal treatment and avoid collecting more personal financial information than necessary.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Protection from Medical Financial Crisis
goals.sharedGoal: Seeking necessary medical care need not destroy a family's financial security.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Restrict abusive medical-debt collection and provide income-sensitive repayment and hardship protections.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Define eligible debts carefully and examine consequences for care prices and providers.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Benefits That Travel With People
goals.sharedGoal: People do not lose basic protections merely because they change jobs.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Make retirement saving and specified worker benefits portable across employers and eligible independent work.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Prevent employers from replacing protected employment benefits with weaker arrangements.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Opportunity to Start Small Enterprises
goals.sharedGoal: People can start lawful, useful enterprises without unnecessary barriers.
goals.category: Economic security and freedom from desperation
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Start a Business in One Day Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Create a consolidated online registration process and simpler rules for genuinely low-risk businesses.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Retain safety, labor, tax, and consumer protections where needed.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Homes People Can Afford
goals.sharedGoal: More people can find safe homes that fit their needs and budgets.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Enable more homes and mixed-use development near jobs and transit where infrastructure allows.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Account for displacement, utilities, local governance, and infrastructure capacity.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Flexible Homes for Changing Families
goals.sharedGoal: Communities can add suitable housing without undermining safety or neighbors' legitimate interests.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Allow code-compliant accessory dwelling units on residential properties.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Maintain fire access, habitability, and reasonable infrastructure requirements.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Fair and Timely Building Decisions
goals.sharedGoal: Construction approvals are consistent, transparent, and completed without needless delay.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Set service deadlines for routine, complete residential permit applications without waiving safety review.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Fund permitting offices and define exceptions for complex proposals.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Public Land Used for Public Benefit
goals.sharedGoal: Underused public property is evaluated openly for housing and other community needs.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer surplus public parcels through transparent processes prioritizing durable affordability and mixed-income homes.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Safeguard ecological, public-access, and community uses; prevent sweetheart deals.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: A Pathway Out of Homelessness
goals.sharedGoal: People experiencing homelessness can reach effective, respectful support.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand permanent supportive housing paired with voluntary, individualized health and social services.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Provide long-term services and evaluate local outcomes rather than assuming one model fits all.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Clear Housing Costs
goals.sharedGoal: Renters and buyers understand full housing costs before making commitments.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Require rental listings to disclose the total mandatory recurring cost and key one-time fees.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Keep disclosures consistent without obscuring legitimate optional charges.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Prevent Housing Crises Early
goals.sharedGoal: Families can find help before a temporary hardship becomes displacement.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Prevent Homelessness Before It Happens Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Provide targeted emergency rental aid, mediation, and eviction diversion for households at acute risk.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Target assistance fairly and test whether interventions prevent homelessness cost-effectively.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Safe Homes for Everyone
goals.sharedGoal: Every resident deserves healthy air, safe structures, and essential utilities.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Require effective remediation of serious hazards with assistance for qualifying property owners and tenants.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Avoid displacing tenants during repairs and make inspections reliable.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Everyday Places Within Reach
goals.sharedGoal: People can reach essential services, work, and community spaces safely and conveniently.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Support safe sidewalks, connected crossings, mixed-use destinations, and accessible routes.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Adapt designs to local needs, disability access, and maintenance budgets.
suggestedMeasures: Residents with safe walking access to services
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Homes Prepared for Local Hazards
goals.sharedGoal: Housing decisions anticipate heat, storms, floods, and other relevant risks.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer targeted grants for insulation, flood protection, storm resilience, and efficient cooling.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Use transparent risk criteria and avoid subsidizing unsafe rebuilding repeatedly.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Care People Can Actually Reach
goals.sharedGoal: People can receive essential medical care when they need it.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer affordable access to essential preventive, primary, and catastrophic care through coverage reforms.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Compare financing pathways, provider capacity, and fiscal sustainability.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Primary Care Close to Home
goals.sharedGoal: Everyone can access trusted frontline care through locally appropriate methods.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand clinics and medical training incentives in areas with documented service shortages.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Avoid building facilities without a sustainable clinical workforce.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Mental and Physical Health With Equal Respect
goals.sharedGoal: Mental-health needs receive serious and effective attention alongside physical health.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Audit and enforce existing mental-health parity standards, with meaningful remedies for violations.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Measure real appointment access, not just written insurance policies.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Compassionate Crisis Response
goals.sharedGoal: People in health or psychological crises receive timely, safe, dignified support.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Community Mental Health Crisis Response Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Fund trained mental-health crisis response teams and coordinated emergency pathways.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect responders and patients; ensure escalation for acute safety threats.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Healthy Pregnancy and Early Childhood
goals.sharedGoal: Parents and babies have access to evidence-based care and informed choices.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Increase access to prenatal, postpartum, and voluntary family support services.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Respect patient choice and tailor care for rural and high-risk communities.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Help to Recover From Addiction
goals.sharedGoal: People seeking recovery can obtain trustworthy, non-stigmatizing assistance.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand medication-assisted treatment, counseling, recovery support, and appropriate diversion programs.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect voluntary informed care and monitor treatment quality.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Prevention Before Illness Becomes Severe
goals.sharedGoal: Preventable disease and suffering are reduced through accessible preventive services.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Reduce out-of-pocket and geographic barriers to recommended preventive care.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Use evidence-based recommendations and monitor unnecessary screening harms.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Care Beyond Major Cities
goals.sharedGoal: Remote communities can reach appropriate health services without unreasonable burdens.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Fund mobile services, telehealth, and emergency-care capacity where regional need is documented.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Address broadband, reimbursement, quality, and continuity of care.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Medicines People Can Afford
goals.sharedGoal: Essential treatments become more affordable while preserving safety and innovation.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Improve timely generic and biosimilar competition and transparent prescription pricing.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Preserve drug quality, innovation incentives, and reliable supplies.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Healthy Food Within Reach
goals.sharedGoal: Communities make nourishing, culturally appropriate food easier to obtain.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand nutritious-food incentives and support viable grocery access in underserved areas.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Avoid stigmatizing recipients and verify that retailers deliver usable access.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Childcare Families Can Rely On
goals.sharedGoal: Caregivers can find safe, affordable childcare choices that work for their households.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Affordable Childcare for Every Family Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Scale quality childcare capacity and offer means-sensitive affordability assistance.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Prevent subsidies from simply increasing prices without expanding supply.
suggestedMeasures: Childcare costs as share of income
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Time to Welcome a New Child
goals.sharedGoal: Parents can bond with a new child without avoidable economic crisis.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Establish paid, job-protected parental leave for births and adoptions through a sustainable financing model.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect smaller employers and equitable access across income groups.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Strong Early Learning Choices
goals.sharedGoal: Young children have optional, high-quality opportunities to learn through play.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer quality early education to families of three- and four-year-olds who choose it.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Preserve parental choice and avoid displacing effective existing providers.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Support in the Earliest Years
goals.sharedGoal: Families can access evidence-based developmental support when children need it.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer voluntary developmental screening, home visiting, and timely early interventions.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect family privacy and avoid overdiagnosis or coercive participation.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Every Child Learns to Read
goals.sharedGoal: Every child gets the support needed to become a confident reader.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Fund effective literacy instruction, educator training, and targeted tutoring.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Use independent evaluation and adapt instruction to each learner.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Learning Without Hunger
goals.sharedGoal: Children can participate in school without preventable hunger.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Provide nutritious school breakfast and lunch without means-tested stigma.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Measure nutritional quality, waste, and cost to districts.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Someone to Talk To at School
goals.sharedGoal: Students can get appropriate guidance and wellbeing support.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Increase access to qualified counselors and school mental-health professionals.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Avoid overloading staff and safeguard confidential student information.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Learn to Think and Disagree Well
goals.sharedGoal: Education develops reasoning, empathy, inquiry, and civic understanding without ideological compulsion.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Critical Thinking and Civic Virtue Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Teach practical logic, media literacy, civil dialogue, empathy, and constitutional reasoning.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Keep curricula transparent and nonpartisan; protect freedom of conscience.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Skills Through Real Experience
goals.sharedGoal: People can gain practical skills through accessible learning and work opportunities.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand paid apprenticeships and employer-education partnerships in high-demand occupations.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Enforce training quality and prevent misuse as cheap labor.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Education Throughout Life
goals.sharedGoal: Adults can keep learning as technology, communities, and careers change.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Create portable education credits for qualified short courses and credentials.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Prevent low-value training providers from capturing the subsidy.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Predictable Time for Workers
goals.sharedGoal: Workers can plan their lives with reasonable notice and predictable arrangements.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Require reasonable advance notice of schedules and compensation for certain late cancellations.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Allow genuine operational exceptions and proportionate rules for small workplaces.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Time to Recover From Illness
goals.sharedGoal: People can take necessary sick leave without punitive consequences.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Guarantee a modest accrual of paid sick time with anti-retaliation protections.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Design fair accrual and administrative rules for varied job types.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Care for Family Without Losing Everything
goals.sharedGoal: People can respond to major caregiving needs without needless financial harm.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer paid caregiving leave for qualifying serious family health needs.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect program solvency and avoid punishing caregivers who work part-time.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: People Are Paid What They Earn
goals.sharedGoal: Workers can reliably receive wages and compensation owed to them.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Improve wage enforcement, restitution speed, and protection against retaliation.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Keep complaint processes fair and accessible to both workers and employers.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Fair Access to Professions
goals.sharedGoal: Qualified people are not blocked from lawful work by unnecessary barriers.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Freedom to Practice Your Profession Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand license reciprocity and remove requirements unrelated to demonstrable public safety.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Retain checks for competence and professions with meaningful risks.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Freedom to Change Jobs
goals.sharedGoal: People can pursue better opportunities without unfair restrictions.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Restrict noncompete clauses that unreasonably limit job changes or new businesses.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Allow legitimate protections for trade secrets and narrowly tailored confidentiality.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Safety in Hot or Hazardous Work
goals.sharedGoal: Employers and workers reduce predictable risks in dangerous conditions.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Safe Work in Extreme Heat Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Require proportionate heat-safety plans including water, rest, shade, and acclimatization.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Adapt thresholds to actual working conditions and implementation costs.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: A Fair Chance to Share in Success
goals.sharedGoal: People can access voluntary ways to share the value their work creates.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Support voluntary employee ownership and transparent profit-sharing through targeted assistance.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Avoid concentrated retirement risk and coercive stock arrangements.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Better Ways to Organize Work
goals.sharedGoal: Communities and workplaces can test schedules that improve wellbeing and productivity.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Fund opt-in shorter-workweek trials with independent measurement of output, staffing, and well-being.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Do not infer one work pattern suits every sector or shift worker.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Time for Life Outside Work
goals.sharedGoal: People can rest and maintain relationships without unreasonable always-on demands.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Protect covered workers against nonessential off-duty contact demands unless compensated or genuinely on-call.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Define emergency exceptions and fair treatment for flexible schedules.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Welcoming Community Places
goals.sharedGoal: People can find affordable places to meet, play, create, and belong.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Support accessible noncommercial gathering spaces such as rec centers and community halls.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Provide stable operating budgets and ensure spaces welcome diverse residents.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Libraries for Everyone
goals.sharedGoal: Communities have trusted, inclusive places for knowledge, tools, and learning.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand library hours, meeting rooms, and community programs where demand supports them.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect library independence and balance staffing and security needs.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Nature and Play Near Home
goals.sharedGoal: People have safe access to parks and everyday outdoor spaces.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: A Park in Every Neighborhood Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Prioritize safe, accessible parks and playgrounds in neighborhoods with the biggest deficits.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Fund maintenance, accessibility, and neighborhood input.
suggestedMeasures: Residents within a short walk of a park
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Opportunities to Share Meals
goals.sharedGoal: Communities can reduce isolation through voluntary, welcoming gatherings.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Offer small competitive grants for free, welcoming community meals.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Use transparent selection and food safety practices; avoid exclusion.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Groups Built Around Shared Interests
goals.sharedGoal: People can join safe, accessible clubs and activities that reflect their interests.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Provide microgrants and meeting access for recurring community groups.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Keep grants viewpoint-neutral and ensure simple reporting.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Trusted Mentors for Young People
goals.sharedGoal: Young people can connect with supportive adults and positive opportunities.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Increase access to supervised mentoring programs with vetted, trained volunteers.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Require child-safety checks, clear consent, and program evaluation.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Friendship Across Generations
goals.sharedGoal: People of different ages have more chances to help and learn from one another.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Support voluntary activities connecting older and younger residents.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Provide safeguarding, accessibility, and meaningful mutual participation.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Support Against Isolation
goals.sharedGoal: People who want connection can access respectful, voluntary support.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Pilot voluntary referrals from providers to vetted clubs, classes, and community groups.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Do not medicalize ordinary solitude or replace needed clinical treatment.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Art and Culture for Everyone
goals.sharedGoal: People can create and enjoy cultural life regardless of income or background.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Support local arts studios, concerts, theater, and low-cost creative instruction.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Award funding transparently with artistic independence.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Making It Easier to Help
goals.sharedGoal: People who want to volunteer can contribute safely with fewer avoidable obstacles.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Reimburse qualifying childcare, transport, and accessibility expenses for approved volunteer work.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Keep paperwork light and avoid displacing paid work.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Justice People Can Reach
goals.sharedGoal: People can understand and use fair legal processes regardless of wealth.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand legal support for qualifying housing, debt, family, and other high-stakes civil matters.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Preserve attorney independence and set clear eligibility rules.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Meaningful Second Chances
goals.sharedGoal: People who have completed lawful obligations can rebuild their lives when safely appropriate.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Seal eligible criminal records after suitable periods and conditions, with public-safety exceptions.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Balance rehabilitation, victim interests, and safety-sensitive screening.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Fair Defense for Every Accused Person
goals.sharedGoal: People facing criminal accusations have meaningful access to legal counsel and due process.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Fund public defender staffing, training, and manageable caseloads.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect independent legal representation and outcome transparency.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Restoration When People Choose It
goals.sharedGoal: Victims and communities can consider safe, voluntary restorative approaches when appropriate.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Provide professionally supervised, voluntary restorative processes for carefully screened cases.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Require informed victim consent and forbid coercive participation.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Fair and Accessible Jury Service
goals.sharedGoal: People can fulfill civic legal duties without unreasonable hardship or exclusion.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Increase juror compensation and reimburse essential care and travel expenses.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Keep selection fair and ensure genuine funding.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Safety and Independence for Survivors
goals.sharedGoal: People facing violence or abuse can obtain practical protection and support.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand confidential emergency housing, protective services, and legal assistance.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Prioritize survivor consent, privacy, and effective safety planning.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Inclusion by Design
goals.sharedGoal: People with disabilities can participate with dignity in public and everyday life.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Strengthen accessible public services, transit, buildings, and government websites.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Set achievable schedules and consult people with disabilities directly.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Dignity and Choice in Later Life
goals.sharedGoal: Older people can access support that respects their autonomy and relationships.
goals.sourceProposalTitle: Aging With Dignity at Home Act
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Expand home modifications, community-based care, and respite options for carers.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Protect choice, quality, and fiscal sustainability.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: A Stable Future for Young People in Care
goals.sharedGoal: Young people leaving care have meaningful opportunities for housing, learning, and support.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Provide transition housing, education assistance, and career support for eligible young adults.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Center youth consent and track outcomes beyond program participation.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Peaceful Local Conflict Resolution
goals.sharedGoal: Communities have accessible ways to address disputes before they escalate.
goals.illustrativeLocalOption: Make voluntary, qualified mediation accessible for suitable civil and neighborhood disagreements.
goals.risksAndSafeguards: Do not pressure vulnerable parties to settle or undermine legal rights.
goals.jurisdiction: Locally determined; review sovereign, tribal, regional, national, and international competence as applicable

goals.title: Trustworthy Civic Participation
